cat > probes/s02_functional.fss <<'EOF'
(* Skeleton F: FUNCTIONAL backprop on carriers.  Every value -- a number, a
   vector, a matrix -- carries a linear map from its own cotangent to the
   cotangent of the loss with respect to all parameters (a Grad record keyed by
   parameter name).  Composition is the chain rule, sharing is handled by
   summing Grads at fan-out, nothing is mutated, and the backward maps are
   written in the same algebra as the forward pass (g x^T, W^T g, ...).
   Finite-difference checked; timed. *)
component s02_functional
import List.{...}
import Map.{...}
export Executable

(* ---- the cotangent record: parameter name |-> dL/dParameter, an additive monoid ---- *)
object Grad(m: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\])
  opr +(self, o: Grad): Grad = Grad(m.union(fn (k, a, b) => a + b, o.m))
  opr [k: String]: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = m[k]
end
zero: Grad = Grad({[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] })

(* ---- carriers: a value and its backward map ---- *)
object Num(a: RR64, vjp: RR64 -> Grad)
  back(g: RR64): Grad = vjp(g)
end
object Vec(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], vjp: Vec -> Grad)
  back(g: Vec): Grad = vjp(g)
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = |a|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: RR64 = a[i]
end
object Mat(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], vjp: Mat -> Grad)
  back(g: Mat): Grad = vjp(g)
  opr [i: ZZ32, j: ZZ32]: RR64 = a[i, j]
end
object Row(x: Vec) end                       (* a transposed vector *)
const(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Vec = Vec(a, fn g => zero)
const(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Mat = Mat(a, fn g => zero)
param(name: String, a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Mat =
  Mat(a, fn g => Grad({[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] name |-> g.a }))

(* ---- the operators: value, then the chain rule ---- *)
opr juxtaposition(W: Mat, x: Vec): Vec = Vec(W.a x.a, fn g => W.back(g x^T) + x.back(W^T g))
opr juxtaposition(g: Vec, xT: Row): Mat =                             (* outer product g x^T *)
  Mat(array[\RR64\](|g|, |xT.x|).fill(fn (i, j) => g[i] (xT.x)[j]), fn G => zero)
opr +(x: Vec, y: Vec): Vec = Vec(x.a + y.a, fn g => x.back(g) + y.back(g))
opr (x: Vec)^T: Row = Row(x)
opr (W: Mat)^T: Mat = Mat(W.a.t(), fn g => W.back(g^T))
opr juxtaposition(c: RR64, x: Vec): Vec = Vec(c x.a, fn g => x.back(c g))
opr DOT(x: Vec, y: Vec): Num = Num(x.a DOT y.a, fn g => x.back(g y) + y.back(g x))
relu(x: Vec): Vec = Vec(x.a.map[\RR64\](fn e => e MAX 0.0), fn g => x.back(g pmul step(x)))
step(x: Vec): Vec = const(x.a.map[\RR64\](fn e => if e > 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end))
pmul(x: Vec, y: Vec): Vec = Vec(x.a.pmul(y.a), fn g => x.back(g pmul y) + y.back(g pmul x))
backward(L: Num): Grad = L.back(1.0)

model(W1: Mat, W2: Mat, x: Vec): Num = do
  h = W1 x
  u = h + W2^T (W2 relu(h))
  u DOT u
end

run(): () = do
  W1v = array[\RR64\](3, 4).fill(fn (i, j) => 0.1 (4 i + j + 1) - 0.7)
  W2v = array[\RR64\](2, 3).fill(fn (i, j) => 0.2 (3 i + j) - 0.5)
  xv = array[\RR64\](4).fill(fn i => 1.0 (i + 1) - 2.5)
  L = model(param("W1", W1v), param("W2", W2v), const(xv))
  println("L = " L.a)
  grads = backward(L)
  println("dL/dW1 = " grads["W1"])
  println("dL/dW2 = " grads["W2"])
  h = 1.0/1048576.0
  f(): RR64 = model(param("W1", W1v), param("W2", W2v), const(xv)).a
  var worst: RR64 := 0.0
  for (i, j) <- seq(<|[\(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] (0,0), (2,3), (1,2) |>) do
    W1v[i,j] := W1v[i,j] + h; fp = f(); W1v[i,j] := W1v[i,j] - 2.0 h; fm = f(); W1v[i,j] := W1v[i,j] + h
    worst := worst MAX |(fp - fm)/(2.0 h) - grads["W1"][i,j]|
  end
  for (i, j) <- seq(<|[\(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] (0,0), (1,2), (0,1) |>) do
    W2v[i,j] := W2v[i,j] + h; fp = f(); W2v[i,j] := W2v[i,j] - 2.0 h; fm = f(); W2v[i,j] := W2v[i,j] + h
    worst := worst MAX |(fp - fm)/(2.0 h) - grads["W2"][i,j]|
  end
  println("max |analytic - finite difference| = " worst)
  t0 = nanoTime()
  for r <- seq(0#20) do backward(model(param("W1", W1v), param("W2", W2v), const(xv))) end
  println("20 x (forward + backward): " ((nanoTime() - t0) / 1000000) " ms")
end
end
EOF

cat > probes/s01_tape.fss <<'EOF'
(* Skeleton T: a TAPE at the tensor level.  A node holds its value (a library
   array), a mutable adjoint `grad` (a library array: a carrier-typed adjoint
   would need a lazily allocated grad, since every carrier would allocate its
   own), and for each child the map from the node's adjoint to the child's
   adjoint (the transposed Jacobian).  backward() walks the graph in reverse
   topological order and accumulates -- Karpathy's design lifted from scalars
   to vectors and matrices.  The adjoint maps work on raw arrays, so transpose
   is the library's .t() and the outer product a function (c09: a user ^T
   cannot be overloaded on the two Array instantiations).  Finite-difference
   checked; timed. *)
component s01_tape
import List.{...}
export Executable

outer(g: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], x: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] =
  array[\RR64\](|g|, |x|).fill(fn (i, j) => g[i] x[j])
relu(x: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = x.map[\RR64\](fn e => e MAX 0.0)
step(x: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = x.map[\RR64\](fn e => if e > 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end)

(* ---- the graph ---- *)
trait Node
  getter children(): List[\Node\]
  push(): ()                              (* send this node's adjoint to its children *)
end
trait Dep0  getter child(): Node; push(g: RR64): () end                           (* deps of a Num parent *)
trait Dep1  getter child(): Node; push(g: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): () end             (* deps of a Vec parent *)
trait Dep2  getter child(): Node; push(g: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): () end      (* deps of a Mat parent *)

object Num(v: RR64, deps: List[\Dep0\]) extends Node
  var grad: RR64 := 0.0
  getter children(): List[\Node\] = <|[\Node\] d.child | d <- deps |>
  push(): () = for d <- seq(deps) do d.push(grad) end
end
object Vec(v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], deps: List[\Dep1\]) extends Node
  var grad: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] := array[\RR64\](|v|).fill(0.0)
  getter children(): List[\Node\] = <|[\Node\] d.child | d <- deps |>
  push(): () = for d <- seq(deps) do d.push(grad) end
end
object Mat(v: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], deps: List[\Dep2\]) extends Node
  var grad: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] := do (n, m) = v.sizes; array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(0.0) end
  getter children(): List[\Node\] = <|[\Node\] d.child | d <- deps |>
  push(): () = for d <- seq(deps) do d.push(grad) end
end

(* (child, transposed Jacobian) pairs: one object per (parent kind, child kind) *)
object VV(c: Vec, f: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] -> Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]) extends Dep1
  getter child(): Node = c
  push(g: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): () = c.grad := c.grad + f(g)
end
object VM(c: Mat, f: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]) extends Dep1
  getter child(): Node = c
  push(g: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): () = c.grad := c.grad + f(g)
end
object MM(c: Mat, f: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]) extends Dep2
  getter child(): Node = c
  push(g: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): () = c.grad := c.grad + f(g)
end
object NV(c: Vec, f: RR64 -> Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]) extends Dep0
  getter child(): Node = c
  push(g: RR64): () = c.grad := c.grad + f(g)
end
dep(c: Vec, f: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] -> Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Dep1 = VV(c, f)
dep(c: Mat, f: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] -> Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Dep1 = VM(c, f)
vec(v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], deps: Dep1...): Vec = Vec(v, deps)
mat(v: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], deps: Dep2...): Mat = Mat(v, deps)
num(v: RR64, deps: Dep0...): Num = Num(v, deps)

(* ---- the operators: value, then for each child the map g |-> J^T g ---- *)
opr juxtaposition(W: Mat, x: Vec): Vec = vec(W.v x.v, dep(W, fn g => outer(g, x.v)), dep(x, fn g => W.v.t() g))
opr +(a: Vec, b: Vec): Vec = vec(a.v + b.v, dep(a, fn g => g), dep(b, fn g => g))
opr (W: Mat)^T: Mat = mat(W.v.t(), MM(W, fn g => g.t()))
relu(x: Vec): Vec = vec(relu(x.v), dep(x, fn g => g.pmul(step(x.v))))
opr DOT(x: Vec, y: Vec): Num = num(x.v DOT y.v, NV(x, fn g => g y.v), NV(y, fn g => g x.v))

(* ---- reverse topological order by object identity, then accumulate ---- *)
topo(root: Node): List[\Node\] = do
  var seen: List[\Node\] := <|[\Node\] |>
  var order: List[\Node\] := <|[\Node\] |>
  visit(n: Node): () =
    if NOT (BIG OR[s <- seen] (s === n)) then
      seen := seen.addRight(n)
      for c <- seq(n.children) do visit(c) end
      order := order.addRight(n)
    end
  visit(root)
  order
end
backward(L: Num): () = do
  L.grad := 1.0
  for n <- seq(topo(L).reverse) do n.push() end
end

model(W1: Mat, W2: Mat, x: Vec): Num = do
  h = W1 x
  u = h + W2^T (W2 relu(h))
  u DOT u
end

run(): () = do
  W1v = array[\RR64\](3, 4).fill(fn (i, j) => 0.1 (4 i + j + 1) - 0.7)
  W2v = array[\RR64\](2, 3).fill(fn (i, j) => 0.2 (3 i + j) - 0.5)
  xv = array[\RR64\](4).fill(fn i => 1.0 (i + 1) - 2.5)
  (W1, W2, x) = (mat(W1v), mat(W2v), vec(xv))
  L = model(W1, W2, x)
  println("L = " L.v)
  backward(L)
  println("dL/dx  = " x.grad)
  println("dL/dW1 = " W1.grad)
  println("dL/dW2 = " W2.grad)
  h = 1.0/1048576.0
  f(): RR64 = model(mat(W1v), mat(W2v), vec(xv)).v
  var worst: RR64 := 0.0
  for k <- seq(0#4) do
    xv[k] := xv[k] + h; fp = f(); xv[k] := xv[k] - 2.0 h; fm = f(); xv[k] := xv[k] + h
    worst := worst MAX |(fp - fm)/(2.0 h) - x.grad[k]|
  end
  for (i, j) <- seq(<|[\(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] (0,0), (2,3), (1,2) |>) do
    W1v[i,j] := W1v[i,j] + h; fp = f(); W1v[i,j] := W1v[i,j] - 2.0 h; fm = f(); W1v[i,j] := W1v[i,j] + h
    worst := worst MAX |(fp - fm)/(2.0 h) - W1.grad[i,j]|
  end
  for (i, j) <- seq(<|[\(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] (0,0), (1,2), (0,1) |>) do
    W2v[i,j] := W2v[i,j] + h; fp = f(); W2v[i,j] := W2v[i,j] - 2.0 h; fm = f(); W2v[i,j] := W2v[i,j] + h
    worst := worst MAX |(fp - fm)/(2.0 h) - W2.grad[i,j]|
  end
  println("max |analytic - finite difference| = " worst)
  t0 = nanoTime()
  for r <- seq(0#20) do backward(model(mat(W1v), mat(W2v), vec(xv))) end
  println("20 x (forward + backward): " ((nanoTime() - t0) / 1000000) " ms")
end
end
EOF

(* c11: three object-model details the engine design hinges on.
   (1) a list literal of two DIFFERENT object types where a List of their
       common trait is expected (ledger row 20 says the element type is the
       runtime class);
   (2) an abstract getter in a trait satisfied by a `var` field of an object,
       and read through the trait type;
   (3) a user-declared setter that absorbs assignments (so a constant can
       swallow `c.grad += g`), and `+=` through it. *)
component c11_object_model
import List.{...}
export Executable

trait Node
  getter grad(): RR64
  setter grad(g: RR64): ()
end
object Leaf(v: RR64) extends Node
  var grad: RR64 := 0.0
end
object Const(v: RR64) extends Node
  getter grad(): RR64 = 0.0
  setter grad(g: RR64): () = ()
end
object Other(name: String) extends Node
  var grad: RR64 := 0.0
end

bump(n: Node): () = n.grad += 1.0

run(): () = do
  a = Leaf(1.0); c = Const(2.0); o = Other("o")
  bump(a); bump(a); bump(c); bump(o)
  println("(2)(3) a.grad = " a.grad "  c.grad = " c.grad "  o.grad = " o.grad)
  xs: List[\Node\] = <| a, c, o |>
  println("(1) heterogeneous literal into List[\\Node\\]: |xs| = " |xs|)
  for n <- seq(xs) do println("   " n.grad) end
end
end
EOF

\section{Field Declarations}
\seclabel{fields}

\begin{Grammar}
\emph{FldDecl}
&::=& \option{\emph{FldMods}} \emph{FldWTypes} \emph{InitVal} \\
&$|$& \emph{BindIdOrBindIdTuple} \EXP{=} \emph{Expr}\\
&$|$& \option{\emph{FldMods}} \emph{BindIdOrBindIdTuple} \EXP{\mathrel{\mathtt{:}}} \emph{Type}\EXP{...}
\emph{InitVal} \\
&$|$& \option{\emph{FldMods}} \emph{BindIdOrBindIdTuple} \EXP{\mathrel{\mathtt{:}}} \emph{TupleType}
\emph{InitVal} \\

\emph{FldMods} &::=& \emph{FldMod}$^+$\\

\emph{FldMod} &::=& \KWD{var} $|$ \emph{AbsFldMod}\\

\emph{AbsFldMod} &::=& \emph{ApiFldMod} $|$ \KWD{wrapped} $|$ \KWD{private}\\

\emph{ApiFldMod} &::=& \KWD{hidden} $|$ \KWD{settable} $|$ \KWD{test}\\

\emph{FldWTypes} &::=& \emph{FldWType} \\
&$|$& \texttt{(} \emph{FldWType}(\EXP{,} \emph{FldWType})$^+$ \texttt{)}\\

\emph{FldWType} &::=& \emph{BindId} \emph{IsType}\\

\end{Grammar}


\note{I think this should be phrased differently.
When I originally read that, I took it to mean
that fields were always ``private.'' -- Scott}
Fields are variables local to an object.
They must not be referred to outside their enclosing object declarations.
Each field is either a non-transient value parameter of a constructor
declaration, or it is explicitly defined by a field declaration within the body of a constructor
declaration, a singleton declaration, or an object expression
(described in \secref{object-expr}).
A field declaration in an object declaration is syntactically identical to
a top-level variable declaration (described in \secref{top-var-decls}),
with the same meanings attached to the form of variable declarations.
Additional modifiers apply to fields, as described in \secref{abstract-fields}.  Unlike with an abstract field in a trait declaration, an object declaration may declare a \KWD{hidden} field which is not \KWD{settable}.

Each field declaration includes an \emph{initial-value} expression,
which specifies the initial value of that field.
Field initialization occurs in textual program order:
evaluation of each initial-value expression
must complete before evaluation of the next initial-value expression,
and all previous field names
(and the parameters of the constructor,
in a constructor declaration)
are in scope when evaluating an initial-value expression
(see~\secref{scope}).
All fields of an object are initialized
before that object is made available for subsequent computation;
thus,
it is illegal to invoke methods on
an object being initialized:
\KWD{self} is \emph{not} implicitly declared by a field declaration.

\note{

\begin{Fortress}

\(         \KWD{end}\)\-\\\poptabs
\(   g() = 4\)\-\\\poptabs
\( \KWD{end}\)\-\\\poptabs

{\tt~}\pushtabs\=\+\( \KWD{trait}\:T\)\\

Fields are variables local to an object.
They must not be referred to outside their enclosing object declarations.
Each field is either a non-transient value parameter of a constructor
declaration, or it is explicitly defined by a field declaration within the body of a constructor
declaration, a singleton declaration, or an object expression
(described in \secref{object-expr}).
A field declaration in an object declaration is syntactically identical to
a top-level variable declaration (described in \secref{top-var-decls}),
with the same meanings attached to the form of variable declarations.
Additional modifiers apply to fields, as described in \secref{abstract-fields}.  Unlike with an abstract field in a trait declaration, an object declaration may declare a \KWD{hidden} field which is not \KWD{settable}.

Each field declaration includes an \emph{initial-value} expression,
which specifies the initial value of that field.
Field initialization occurs in textual program order:
evaluation of each initial-value expression
must complete before evaluation of the next initial-value expression,
and all previous field names
(and the parameters of the constructor,
in a constructor declaration)
are in scope when evaluating an initial-value expression
(see~\secref{scope}).
All fields of an object are initialized
before that object is made available for subsequent computation;
thus,

(* c13: the two Sigmas the matrix-level design wants, in one component:
   (a) SUM[t <- 0#n] over a list of differentiable scalars (a user reduction
       behind the library's own big operator, ledger row 41: except-import
       plus a nullary opr SUM), and
   (b) a PREFIX `SUM e` over a differentiable VECTOR node, which is not a
       reduction over elements but one graph operation returning a scalar node
       (softmax's denominator, written as the paper's Sigma). *)
component c13_sum_protocol
import FortressLibrary.{...} except { opr BIG + }
import List.{...}
export Executable

object Num(v: RR64, name: String)
  opr +(self, o: Num): Num = Num(v + o.v, "(" name "+" o.name ")")
end
object Vec(v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]) end

object SumNums extends CommutativeMonoidReduction[\Num\]
  getter asString(): String = "SumNums"
  empty(): Num = Num(0.0, "0")
  join(a: Num, b: Num): Num = a + b
end
opr SUM(): BigReduction[\Num, Num\] = BigReduction[\Num, Num\](SumNums)
opr SUM(e: Vec): Num = Num(SUM[x <- e.v] x, "sum(e)")

run(): () = do
  nums = <|[\Num\] Num(1.0, "a"), Num(2.0, "b"), Num(3.0, "c") |>
  s = SUM[t <- 0#3] nums[t]

  println("(c) numeric SUM[i <- 1:4] i (still needed inside (b)) = " (SUM[i <- 1:4] i))
end
end

(* c14: (1) a lazily allocated adjoint: the field holds Maybe[\Mat\], a getter
   returns a zero node of the right shape until the first accumulation, and
   `A.grad += G` goes through the setter -- so a carrier can hold its adjoint
   AS A CARRIER without constructing an infinite chain of zero adjoints;
   (2) a carrier that is a Generator of its elements (x_i <- x, BIG MAX x)
   and a matrix carrier that is a Generator of its ROW nodes (x <- X). *)
component c14_lazy_grad_generators
import List.{...}
export Executable

trait Node
  getter children(): List[\Node\]
  push(): ()
end

object Vec(v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], children: List[\Node\], backprop: Vec -> ())
    extends { Node, ZeroIndexed[\RR64\], DelegatedIndexed[\RR64, ZZ32\] }
  var g: Maybe[\Vec\] := Nothing[\Vec\]
  getter grad(): Vec = if gg <- g then gg else vec(array[\RR64\](|v|).fill(0.0)) end
  setter grad(x: Vec): () = g := Just[\Vec\](x)
  push(): () = backprop(grad)
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0 # |v|
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = |v|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: RR64 = v[i]
end
object Mat(v: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], children: List[\Node\], backprop: Mat -> ())
    extends { Node, ZeroIndexed[\Vec\], DelegatedIndexed[\Vec, ZZ32\] }
  var g: Maybe[\Mat\] := Nothing[\Mat\]
  getter grad(): Mat = if gg <- g then gg else mat(array[\RR64\](rows(self), cols(self)).fill(0.0)) end
  setter grad(x: Mat): () = g := Just[\Mat\](x)
  push(): () = backprop(grad)
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0 # rows(self)
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = rows(self)
  opr [t: ZZ32]: Vec = row(self, t)
end
rows(X: Mat): ZZ32 = do (n, m) = X.v.sizes; n end
cols(X: Mat): ZZ32 = do (n, m) = X.v.sizes; m end
vec(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Vec = Vec(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn g => ())
mat(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Mat = Mat(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn g => ())
opr +(x: Vec, y: Vec): Vec = Vec(x.v + y.v, <|[\Node\] x, y |>, fn g => do x.grad += g; y.grad += g end)
opr +(X: Mat, Y: Mat): Mat = Mat(X.v + Y.v, <|[\Node\] X, Y |>, fn G => do X.grad += G; Y.grad += G end)
(* row t of a matrix node: a vector node whose adjoint scatters back into row t *)
row(X: Mat, t: ZZ32): Vec =
  Vec(X.v[t, :].copy(), <|[\Node\] X |>,
      fn g => X.grad += mat(array[\RR64\](rows(X), cols(X)).fill(fn (i, j) => if i = t then g[j] else 0.0 end)))

run(): () = do
  x = vec(array[\RR64\](3).fill(fn i => 1.0 (i + 1)))
  y = x + x
  println("y.grad before: " y.grad.v)
  y.grad += vec(array[\RR64\](3).fill(1.0))
  y.grad += vec(array[\RR64\](3).fill(1.0))
  println("y.grad after two += : " y.grad.v)
  y.push()
  println("x.grad after push (2 per use, 2 uses) : " x.grad.v)
  println("BIG MAX over x's elements: " (BIG MAX[x_i <- x] x_i) "   |x| = " |x| "  x[1] = " x[1])
  println("comprehension over elements: " <| 2 x_i | x_i <- x |>)
  X = mat(array[\RR64\](2, 3).fill(fn (i, j) => 1.0 (3 i + j)))
  Z = X + X
  println("rows of Z as nodes: " <| r.v | r <- Z |>)
  for r <- Z do r.grad += vec(array[\RR64\](3).fill(1.0)) end
  for r <- seq(Z) do r.push() end
  println("Z.grad after each row pushed ones: " Z.grad.v)
  Z.push()
  println("X.grad: " X.grad.v)
end
end
EOF

"""Generate src/MicroGPTData.{fsi,fss} from checks/goldens_2steps.json.

Numbers are emitted as decimal expansions of Python's shortest round-trip repr
(Fortress numerals have no exponent notation, ledger row 14); the expansion
parses back to the same double.  Every declaration is prefixed ref_ so the
names cannot collide with the program's own.
"""
import json, os, sys
from decimal import Decimal

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SRC = os.path.join(HERE, '..', 'src')
checks = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else os.path.join(HERE, '..', 'checks', 'goldens_2steps.json')
d = json.load(open(checks))

def num(x):
    r = repr(float(x))
    if 'e' in r or 'E' in r:
        r = format(Decimal(r), 'f')
    if '.' not in r:
        r += '.0'
    return r
def lst(xs): return '<|[\\RR64\\] ' + ', '.join(num(x) for x in xs) + '|>'
def mat(rows): return '<|[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]\n    ' + ',\n    '.join(lst(r) for r in rows) + ' |>'
def cube(cs): return '<|[\\List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]\\]\n  ' + ',\n  '.join(mat(c) for c in cs) + ' |>'
def ints(xs): return '<|[\\ZZ32\\] ' + ', '.join(str(int(x)) for x in xs) + '|>'
def ints2(rows): return '<|[\\List[\\ZZ32\\]\\] ' + ', '.join(ints(r) for r in rows) + '|>'
def strs(xs): return '<|[\\String\\] ' + ', '.join('"%s"' % x for x in xs) + '|>'

fsi, fss = [], []
def decl(sig, body):
    sig = 'ref_' + sig
    fsi.append(sig); fss.append(sig + ' = ' + body)

cfg = d['config']
decl('uchars: String', '"%s"' % cfg['uchars'])
decl('bos: ZZ32', str(cfg['BOS']))
decl('vocab_size: ZZ32', str(cfg['vocab_size']))
decl('n_embd: ZZ32', str(cfg['n_embd']))
decl('n_head: ZZ32', str(cfg['n_head']))
decl('n_layer: ZZ32', str(cfg['n_layer']))
decl('block_size: ZZ32', str(cfg['block_size']))
decl('source_sha256: String', '"%s"' % d['source_sha256'])
names = list(d['init'].keys())
decl('names(): List[\\String\\]', strs(names))
def fname(k): return k.replace('.', '_')
for k in names:
    decl('init_%s(): List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]' % fname(k), mat(d['init'][k]))
steps = d['steps']
decl('num_steps: ZZ32', str(len(steps)))
decl('docs(): List[\\String\\]', strs([st['doc'] for st in steps]))
decl('docs_head(): List[\\String\\]', strs(d['docs_head']))
decl('tokens(): List[\\List[\\ZZ32\\]\\]', ints2([st['tokens'] for st in steps]))
decl('logits(): List[\\List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]\\]', cube([[p['logits'] for p in st['positions']] for st in steps]))
decl('probs(): List[\\List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]\\]', cube([[p['probs'] for p in st['positions']] for st in steps]))
decl('losses(): List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]', mat([[p['loss'] for p in st['positions']] for st in steps]))
decl('loss(): List[\\RR64\\]', lst([st['loss'] for st in steps]))
decl('lr(): List[\\RR64\\]', lst([st['lr_t'] for st in steps]))
for k in names:
    decl('grad_%s(): List[\\List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]\\]' % fname(k), cube([st['grads'][k] for st in steps]))
    decl('after_%s(): List[\\List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]\\]' % fname(k), cube([st['params_after'][k] for st in steps]))
inf = d['inference']; smps = inf['samples']
decl('temperature: RR64', num(inf['temperature']))
decl('num_samples: ZZ32', str(len(smps)))
decl('sample_text(): List[\\String\\]', strs([s['text'] for s in smps]))
decl('sample_draws(): List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]', mat([[u for st in s['steps'] for u in st['draw']] for s in smps]))
decl('sample_tokens(): List[\\List[\\ZZ32\\]\\]', ints2([[st['token'] for st in s['steps']] for s in smps]))
decl('sample_probs(): List[\\List[\\List[\\RR64\\]\\]\\]', cube([[st['probs'] for st in s['steps']] for s in smps]))

open(os.path.join(SRC, 'MicroGPTData.fsi'), 'w').write('api MicroGPTData\nimport List.{...}\n' + '\n'.join(fsi) + '\nend\n')
open(os.path.join(SRC, 'MicroGPTData.fss'), 'w').write(
    '(* GENERATED by tools/gen_data.py from %s (derived from the pinned microgpt.py by reference/derive.py); do not edit. *)\n'
    'component MicroGPTData\nimport List.{...}\nexport MicroGPTData\n' % os.path.basename(checks) + '\n'.join(fss) + '\nend\n')
print('wrote src/MicroGPTData.fsi/.fss:', len(fsi), 'declarations')
EOF

component MicroGPT
import FortressLibrary.{...} except { opr BIG + }
import List.{...}
import Set.{...}
import Map.{...}
export Executable

(********************************************************************
 * Reverse-mode automatic differentiation at the level of vectors and
 * matrices.  A node is a value (one of the library's own arrays of
 * RR64) together with the nodes it was computed from and a backward
 * map: how the adjoint of this node -- dL/dnode, the field grad --
 * flows into the adjoints of its children.  Adjoints are carriers of
 * the same kind as the values, so a backward map is written in the same
 * algebra as the forward pass: for Y = A B it reads
 *     A.grad += G B^T ;  B.grad += A^T G
 * with G the adjoint of Y, exactly as the papers state it.
 ********************************************************************)

var nodeCount: ZZ32 := 0
nextId(): ZZ32 = atomic do nodeCount += 1; nodeCount end

trait Node
  getter id(): ZZ32
  getter children(): List[\Node\]
  push(): ()                    (* send this node's adjoint to its children *)
end

(* FIG carriers *)
object Num(v: RR64, children: List[\Node\], backprop: Num -> ()) extends Node
  id: ZZ32 = nextId()
  var g: Maybe[\Num\] := Nothing[\Num\]
  getter grad(): Num = if x <- g then x else num(0.0) end
  setter grad(x: Num): () = g := Just[\Num\](x)
  push(): () = backprop(self.grad)
end

object Vec(v: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], children: List[\Node\], backprop: Vec -> ())
    extends { Node, ZeroIndexed[\RR64\], DelegatedIndexed[\RR64, ZZ32\] }
  id: ZZ32 = nextId()
  var g: Maybe[\Vec\] := Nothing[\Vec\]
  getter grad(): Vec = if x <- g then x else vec(zeros(|v|)) end
  setter grad(x: Vec): () = g := Just[\Vec\](x)
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0 # |v|
  push(): () = backprop(self.grad)
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = |v|
  opr [i: ZZ32]: RR64 = v[i]
end

object Mat(v: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], children: List[\Node\], backprop: Mat -> ())
    extends { Node, ZeroIndexed[\Vec\], DelegatedIndexed[\Vec, ZZ32\] }
  id: ZZ32 = nextId()
  var g: Maybe[\Mat\] := Nothing[\Mat\]
  getter grad(): Mat = if x <- g then x else mat(zeros(rows(self), cols(self))) end
  setter grad(x: Mat): () = g := Just[\Mat\](x)
  getter indices(): Generator[\ZZ32\] = 0 # rows(self)
  push(): () = backprop(self.grad)
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = rows(self)                  (* the number of rows: positions *)
  (* row t as a node; its adjoint is scattered back into row t *)
  opr [t: ZZ32]: Vec = vec(v[t, :].copy(), fn g => self.grad += rowInto(g, t, rows(self), cols(self)), self)
  (* element (t, j) as a scalar node *)
  opr [t: ZZ32, j: ZZ32]: Num = num(v[t, j], fn g => self.grad += entryInto(g, t, j, rows(self), cols(self)), self)
  (* the rows named by a sequence of indices, as a matrix: E[tokens], P[0#n] *)
  opr [ts: Generator[\ZZ32\]]: Mat = do
    ix = <|[\ZZ32\] t | t <- ts |>
    mat(array[\RR64\](|ix|, cols(self)).fill(fn (i, j) => v[ix[i], j]),
        fn G => self.grad += scatter(G, ix, rows(self)), self)
  end
  (* the columns c, as a matrix: Q[:, c] *)
  opr [_: TrivialOpenRange, c: Range[\ZZ32\]]: Mat = cols(self, c.lower, |c|)
end
(* END FIG *)

rows(X: Mat): ZZ32 = do (n, m) = X.v.sizes; n end
cols(X: Mat): ZZ32 = do (n, m) = X.v.sizes; m end
zeros(n: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,ZZ32\] = array[\RR64\](n).fill(0.0)
zeros(n: ZZ32, m: ZZ32): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(0.0)
infinity: RR64 = 1.0/0.0

(* FIG factories *)
(* constants (no children) and nodes (a backward map, then the children) *)
num(a: RR64): Num = Num(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn g => ())
vec(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): Vec = Vec(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn g => ())
mat(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Mat = Mat(a, <|[\Node\] |>, fn G => ())
num(a: RR64, f: Num -> (), cs: Node...): Num = Num(a, <|[\Node\] c | c <- cs |>, f)
vec(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], f: Vec -> (), cs: Node...): Vec = Vec(a, <|[\Node\] c | c <- cs |>, f)
mat(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], f: Mat -> (), cs: Node...): Mat = Mat(a, <|[\Node\] c | c <- cs |>, f)
(* END FIG *)

(* plumbing on the library's arrays: embedding an adjoint into a larger zero
   matrix, and the elementwise product the library gives vectors but not matrices *)
rowInto(g: Vec, t: ZZ32, n: ZZ32, m: ZZ32): Mat =
  mat(array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(fn (i, j) => if i = t then g[j] else 0.0 end))
entryInto(g: Num, t: ZZ32, j0: ZZ32, n: ZZ32, m: ZZ32): Mat =
  mat(array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(fn (i, j) => if i = t AND j = j0 then g.v else 0.0 end))
colsInto(G: Mat, j0: ZZ32, w: ZZ32, m: ZZ32): Mat =
  mat(array[\RR64\](rows(G), m).fill(fn (i, j) => if j0 <= j < j0 + w then G.v[i, j - j0] else 0.0 end))
scatter(G: Mat, ix: List[\ZZ32\], n: ZZ32): Mat = do
  r = zeros(n, cols(G))
  for t <- seq(ix.indices), j <- 0 # cols(G) do r[ix[t], j] := r[ix[t], j] + G.v[t, j] end
  mat(r)
end
hadamard(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], b: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] =
  a.ivmap[\RR64\](fn (ij, e) => e b.get(ij))
total(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\]): RR64 = SUM[e <- a] e

(********************************************************************
 * The operators: each states its value, then its backward map.
 ********************************************************************)

(* FIG scalars *)
opr +(a: Num, b: Num): Num = num(a.v + b.v, fn g => do a.grad += g; b.grad += g end, a, b)
opr -(a: Num): Num = num(-a.v, fn g => a.grad += -g, a)
opr -(a: Num, b: Num): Num = a + (-b)
opr juxtaposition(a: Num, b: Num): Num = num(a.v b.v, fn g => do a.grad += g b; b.grad += g a end, a, b)
opr /(a: Num, b: Num): Num = num(a.v/b.v, fn g => do a.grad += g/b; b.grad += -(g a)/(b b) end, a, b)
opr juxtaposition(c: RR64, a: Num): Num = num(c a.v, fn g => a.grad += c g, a)
opr +(a: Num, c: RR64): Num = num(a.v + c, fn g => a.grad += g, a)
opr /(a: Num, c: RR64): Num = (1/c) a
opr /(a: Num, n: ZZ32): Num = (1.0/n) a
opr SQRT(a: Num): Num = do s = SQRT a.v; num(s, fn g => a.grad += g/(2 s), a) end
log(a: Num): Num = num(log a.v, fn g => a.grad += g/a, a)
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG vectors *)
opr +(x: Vec, y: Vec): Vec = vec(x.v + y.v, fn g => do x.grad += g; y.grad += g end, x, y)
opr -(x: Vec, c: RR64): Vec = vec(x.v.map[\RR64\](fn e => e - c), fn g => x.grad += g, x)
opr ODOT(x: Vec, y: Vec): Vec = vec(x.v.pmul(y.v), fn g => do x.grad += g ODOT y; y.grad += g ODOT x end, x, y)
opr DOT(x: Vec, y: Vec): Num = num(x.v DOT y.v, fn g => do x.grad += g y; y.grad += g x end, x, y)
opr juxtaposition(c: Num, x: Vec): Vec = vec(c.v x.v, fn g => do c.grad += g DOT x; x.grad += c g end, c, x)
opr /(x: Vec, s: Num): Vec = vec(x.v.scale(1/s.v), fn g => do x.grad += g/s; s.grad += -((g DOT x)/(s s)) end, x, s)
exp(x: Vec): Vec = do e = x.v.map[\RR64\](fn t => exp t); vec(e, fn g => x.grad += g ODOT vec(e), x) end
opr SUM(x: Vec): Num = num(total(x.v), fn g => x.grad += g ones(|x|), x)
ones(n: ZZ32): Vec = vec(array[\RR64\](n).fill(1.0))
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG matrices *)
opr juxtaposition(A: Mat, B: Mat): Mat = mat(A.v B.v, fn G => do A.grad += G B^T; B.grad += A^T G end, A, B)
opr (A: Mat)^T: Mat = mat(A.v.t(), fn G => A.grad += G^T, A)
opr +(A: Mat, B: Mat): Mat = mat(A.v + B.v, fn G => do A.grad += G; B.grad += G end, A, B)
opr ODOT(A: Mat, B: Mat): Mat = mat(hadamard(A.v, B.v), fn G => do A.grad += G ODOT B; B.grad += G ODOT A end, A, B)
opr /(A: Mat, c: RR64): Mat = mat(A.v.scale(1/c), fn G => A.grad += G/c, A)
relu(X: Mat): Mat = mat(X.v.map[\RR64\](fn e => e MAX 0.0), fn G => X.grad += G ODOT step(X), X)
step(X: Mat): Mat = mat(X.v.map[\RR64\](fn e => if e > 0.0 then 1.0 else 0.0 end))
cols(X: Mat, j0: ZZ32, w: ZZ32): Mat =
  mat(X.v[(0, j0) # (rows(X), w)].copy(), fn G => X.grad += colsInto(G, j0, w, cols(X)), X)
(* rows stacked into a matrix; each row's adjoint is the matching row of G *)
stack(xs: List[\Vec\]): Mat =
  Mat(array[\RR64\](|xs|, |xs[0]|).fill(fn (t, j) => (xs[t]).v[j]), <|[\Node\] x | x <- xs |>,
      fn G => for (t, x) <- xs.indexValuePairs do x.grad += G[t] end)
(* column-wise concatenation, and the same as a big operator over heads *)
opr ||(A: Mat, B: Mat): Mat = do
  (ca, cb) = (cols(A), cols(B))
  mat(array[\RR64\](rows(A), ca + cb).fill(fn (i, j) => if j < ca then A.v[i, j] else B.v[i, j - ca] end),
      fn G => do A.grad += cols(G, 0, ca); B.grad += cols(G, ca, cb) end, A, B)
end
object CatMats extends MonoidReduction[\Mat\]
  getter asString(): String = "CatMats"
  empty(): Mat = mat(zeros(0, 0))
  join(a: Mat, b: Mat): Mat = a || b
end
opr BIG ||(): BigReduction[\Mat, Mat\] = BigReduction[\Mat, Mat\](CatMats)
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG sum *)
(* Sigma over anything that has a +: scalars, numbers, nodes.  The library's
   own SUM is sealed to Number, so it is hidden by the except-import above and
   redeclared once, over a reduction whose join dispatches on its arguments. *)
object PlusReduction extends CommutativeMonoidReduction[\Any\]
  getter asString(): String = "PlusReduction"
  empty(): Any = 0
  join(a: Any, b: Any): Any = a + b
end
opr SUM(): BigReduction[\Any, Any\] = BigReduction[\Any, Any\](PlusReduction)
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG backward *)
(* every node after all the nodes it depends on *)
topo(root: Node): List[\Node\] = do
  var seen: Set[\ZZ32\] := {[\ZZ32\] }
  var order: List[\Node\] := <|[\Node\] |>
  visit(n: Node): () =
    if n.id NOTIN seen then
      seen := seen.add(n.id)
      for c <- seq(n.children) do visit(c) end
      order := order.addRight(n)
    end
  visit(root)
  order
end
backward(L: Num): () = do
  L.grad := num(1.0)
  for n <- seq(topo(L).reverse) do n.push() end
end
(* END FIG *)

(********************************************************************
 * The model
 ********************************************************************)

epsilon: RR64 = 10.0^(-5)

(* FIG rmsnorm *)
rmsnorm(x: Vec): Vec = x/(SQRT((x DOT x)/|x| + epsilon))
rmsnorm(X: Mat): Mat = stack(<| rmsnorm(x) | x <- X |>)
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG softmax *)
softmax(z: Vec): Vec = do e = exp(z - (BIG MAX z)); e/(SUM e) end
softmax(Z: Mat): Mat = stack(<| softmax(z) | z <- Z |>)
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG attention *)
(* causal mask: a position attends to itself and the positions before it *)
mask(n: ZZ32): Mat = mat(array[\RR64\](n, n).fill(fn (i, j) => if j > i then -infinity else 0.0 end))

attend(Q: Mat, K: Mat, V: Mat): Mat = do
  d_k = cols(Q)
  softmax((Q K^T)/(SQRT d_k) + mask(|Q|)) V
end
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG layer *)
object Layer(n_head: ZZ32, W_q: Mat, W_k: Mat, W_v: Mat, W_o: Mat, W_in: Mat, W_out: Mat)
  attention(X: Mat): Mat = do
    (Q, K, V) = (X W_q^T, X W_k^T, X W_v^T)
    d_h = cols(Q) DIV n_head
    head(h: ZZ32): Mat = do c = (h d_h) # d_h; attend(Q[:, c], K[:, c], V[:, c]) end
    (BIG ||[h <- 0#n_head] head(h)) W_o^T
  end
  mlp(X: Mat): Mat = relu(X W_in^T) W_out^T
  forward(X: Mat): Mat = do
    X' = X + attention(rmsnorm(X))
    X' + mlp(rmsnorm(X'))
  end
  matrices(): List[\Mat\] = <| W_q, W_k, W_v, W_o, W_in, W_out |>
end
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG model *)
object Model(E: Mat, P: Mat, W_lm: Mat, layers: List[\Layer\])
  (* logits for the next token at every position *)
  forward(tokens: List[\ZZ32\]): Mat = do
    var X: Mat := rmsnorm(E[tokens] + P[0 # |tokens|])
    for l <- seq(layers) do X := l.forward(X) end
    X W_lm^T
  end
  matrices(): List[\Mat\] = <| E, P, W_lm |> || (BIG CONCAT[\Mat\][l <- layers] l.matrices())
end
(* END FIG *)

(* FIG loss *)
(* cross-entropy of the next token, averaged over the positions *)
loss(model: Model, tokens: List[\ZZ32\]): Num = do
  n = |tokens| - 1
  P = softmax(model.forward(tokens[0 # n]))
  -(1/n) (SUM[t <- 0#n] log P[t, tokens[t + 1]])
end
(* END FIG *)

(* TESTS *)
randomMat(n: ZZ32, m: ZZ32, std: RR64): Mat = mat(array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(fn (i, j) => std (2 random(1.0) - 1)))

run(): () = do
  (d, nh, vocab, block) = (16, 4, 27, 16)
  layer = Layer(nh, randomMat(d, d, 0.08), randomMat(d, d, 0.08), randomMat(d, d, 0.08),
                randomMat(d, d, 0.08), randomMat(4 d, d, 0.08), randomMat(d, 4 d, 0.08))
  model = Model(randomMat(vocab, d, 0.08), randomMat(block, d, 0.08), randomMat(vocab, d, 0.08), <| layer |>)
  tokens = <|[\ZZ32\] 26, 4, 12, 12, 0, 26 |>
  recordTime(0)
  L = loss(model, tokens)
  println("loss: " L.v "  (ln 27 = " (log 27.0) ")  nodes: " nodeCount)
  printTime(0)
  recordTime(1)
  backward(L)
  printTime(1)
  (* finite differences on three parameter entries *)
  h = 1.0/1048576.0
  f(): RR64 = loss(model, tokens).v
  worst: RR64 := 0.0
  for (W, i, j) <- seq(<|[\(Mat, ZZ32, ZZ32)\] (model.E, 26, 3), (layer.W_q, 5, 7), (layer.W_out, 2, 40) |>) do
    a = W.grad.v[i, j]
    W.v[i, j] := W.v[i, j] + h; fp = f(); W.v[i, j] := W.v[i, j] - 2 h; fm = f(); W.v[i, j] := W.v[i, j] + h
    fd = (fp - fm)/(2 h)
    println("  analytic " a "  finite difference " fd)
    worst := worst MAX |a - fd|
  end
  println("max |analytic - finite difference| = " worst)
end
(* END TESTS *)
end
EOF

"""Typeset marked regions of the actual source.

Extracts every (* FIG name *) ... (* END FIG *) region of a Fortress source file
into figures/PREFIX_name.tic and renders it with figures/render.sh, so a figure
can only ever show what the interpreter runs.  Usage:
    tools/figs.py SRC.fss PREFIX [name ...]
"""
import os, re, subprocess, sys, textwrap
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
FIG = os.path.join(HERE, '..', 'figures')
src, prefix = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
only = set(sys.argv[3:])
text = open(src).read()
HEADER = r"""\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fortify}
\usepackage[active,tightpage]{preview}
\setlength\PreviewBorder{8pt}
\begin{document}
\begin{preview}
"""
FOOTER = "\n\\end{preview}\n\\end{document}\n"
for m in re.finditer(r'\(\* FIG (\w+) \*\)\n(.*?)\n[ \t]*\(\* END FIG \*\)', text, flags=re.S):
    name, body = m.group(1), textwrap.dedent(m.group(2))
    if only and name not in only: continue
    fname = '%s_%s' % (prefix, name)
    open(os.path.join(FIG, fname + '.tic'), 'w').write(HEADER + '`' + body.rstrip() + '`' + FOOTER)
    r = subprocess.run([os.path.join(FIG, 'render.sh'), fname], capture_output=True, text=True)
    last = [l for l in r.stdout.strip().split('\n') if 'exit' in l]
    print(fname, last[-1] if last else r.stdout[-300:])
EOF

    extends { Node, Generator[\\Vec\\] }
  id: ZZ32 = nextId()
  var adj: Maybe[\\Mat\\] := Nothing[\\Mat\\]
  getter grad(): Mat = if x <- adj then x else mat(zeros(rows(self), cols(self))) end
  setter grad(x: Mat): () = adj := Just[\\Mat\\](x)
  push(): () = backprop(self.grad)
  opr |self|: ZZ32 = rows(self)                  (* the number of rows: positions *)
  (* the rows, as nodes, are what a matrix generates: x <- X *)
  generate[\\R\\](r: Reduction[\\R\\], body: Vec -> R): R =
    (0 # rows(self)).generate[\\R\\](r, fn t => body(self[t]))
  (* row t as a node; its adjoint is scattered back into row t *)
  opr [t: ZZ32]: Vec = vec(v[t, :].copy(), fn g => self.grad += rowInto(g, t, rows(self), cols(self)), self)
  (* element (t, j) as a scalar node *)
  opr [t: ZZ32, j: ZZ32]: Num = num(v[t, j], fn g => self.grad += entryInto(g, t, j, rows(self), cols(self)), self)
  (* the rows named by a sequence of indices, as a matrix: E[tokens], P[0#n] *)
  opr [ts: Generator[\\ZZ32\\]]: Mat = do

  opr [_: TrivialOpenRange, c: Range[\\ZZ32\\]]: Mat = cols(self, c.lower, |c|)

object Params(m: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\])

opr +(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x + y)
opr -(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x - y)
opr juxtaposition(c: RR64, a: Params): Params = a.each(fn x => x.scale(c))
opr ODOT(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => hadamard(x, y))
opr /(a: Params, c: RR64): Params = a.each(fn x => x.scale(1/c))
opr /(a: Params, b: Params): Params = a.zip(b, fn (x, y) => x.ivmap[\RR64\](fn (ij, e) => e/y.get(ij)))
opr +(a: Params, c: RR64): Params = a.each(fn x => x.map[\RR64\](fn e => e + c))

object Adam(beta1: RR64, beta2: RR64, eps: RR64)

  step(theta: Params, g: Params, m: Params, v: Params, t: ZZ32, eta: RR64): (Params, Params, Params) = do
    m' = beta1 m + (1 - beta1) g
    v' = beta2 v + (1 - beta2) (g ODOT g)
    m_hat = m'/(1 - beta1^t)
    v_hat = v'/(1 - beta2^t)
    (theta - eta m_hat/(SQRT v_hat + eps), m', v')
  end
end

"""Compose runnable components from src/MicroGPT.fss and a driver fragment.

build/NAME.fss = component header + the body of MicroGPT.fss without its
(* TESTS *) region + src/PART.  The data component MicroGPTData is imported.
(The driver is spliced in rather than importing an API of the core: the check
needs the parameter nodes' grad fields and the core's operators, and a
composed component keeps the core file itself free of verification plumbing.)
Usage: tools/build.py PART NAME
"""
import os, re, sys
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
SRC = os.path.join(HERE, '..', 'src'); BUILD = os.path.join(HERE, '..', 'build')
os.makedirs(BUILD, exist_ok=True)
part = sys.argv[1]; name = sys.argv[2]
lib = open(os.path.join(SRC, 'MicroGPT.fss')).read()
body = '\n'.join(ln for ln in lib.split('\n') if not re.match(r'^(component|import|export)\b', ln)).rstrip()
assert body.endswith('end'); body = body[:-3].rstrip() + '\n'
body = re.sub(r'\(\* TESTS \*\).*?\(\* END TESTS \*\)\n?', '', body, flags=re.S)
hdr = ('component %s\nimport FortressLibrary.{...} except { opr BIG + }\nimport List.{...}\nimport Set.{...}\n'
       'import Map.{...}\nimport MicroGPTData.{...}\nexport Executable\n' % name)
frag = open(os.path.join(SRC, part)).read()
out = '(* GENERATED by tools/build.py: MicroGPT.fss (minus its test region) + %s *)\n' % part + hdr + '\n' + body + '\n' + frag + '\nend\n'
dest = os.path.join(BUILD, name + '.fss'); open(dest, 'w').write(out)
print('wrote', dest, len(out.split('\n')), 'lines')
EOF

   from the pinned Python reference (reference/derive.py -> checks/*.json ->
   MicroGPTData): every logit, probability and per-position loss, the loss,

toArr(rows: List[\List[\RR64\]\]): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] =

initOf(name: String): List[\List[\RR64\]\] = case name of

    "layer0.attn_wq" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wq(); "layer0.attn_wk" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wk()
    "layer0.attn_wv" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wv(); "layer0.attn_wo" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wo()
    "layer0.mlp_fc1" => ref_init_layer0_mlp_fc1(); else => ref_init_layer0_mlp_fc2()
  end
gradOf(name: String, k: ZZ32): List[\List[\RR64\]\] = case name of
    "wte" => (ref_grad_wte())[k]; "wpe" => (ref_grad_wpe())[k]; "lm_head" => (ref_grad_lm_head())[k]
    "layer0.attn_wq" => (ref_grad_layer0_attn_wq())[k]; "layer0.attn_wk" => (ref_grad_layer0_attn_wk())[k]
    "layer0.attn_wv" => (ref_grad_layer0_attn_wv())[k]; "layer0.attn_wo" => (ref_grad_layer0_attn_wo())[k]
    "layer0.mlp_fc1" => (ref_grad_layer0_mlp_fc1())[k]; else => (ref_grad_layer0_mlp_fc2())[k]
  end
afterOf(name: String, k: ZZ32): List[\List[\RR64\]\] = case name of
    "wte" => (ref_after_wte())[k]; "wpe" => (ref_after_wpe())[k]; "lm_head" => (ref_after_lm_head())[k]
    "layer0.attn_wq" => (ref_after_layer0_attn_wq())[k]; "layer0.attn_wk" => (ref_after_layer0_attn_wk())[k]
    "layer0.attn_wv" => (ref_after_layer0_attn_wv())[k]; "layer0.attn_wo" => (ref_after_layer0_attn_wo())[k]
    "layer0.mlp_fc1" => (ref_after_layer0_mlp_fc1())[k]; else => (ref_after_layer0_mlp_fc2())[k]
  end

maxAbsDiff(a: Array[\RR64,ZZ32\], b: List[\RR64\]): RR64 = BIG MAX[i <- a.indices] |a[i] - b[i]|
matDiff(a: Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\], rows: List[\List[\RR64\]\]): RR64 = do
  (n, m) = a.sizes
  BIG MAX[i <- 0#n, j <- 0#m] |a[i, j] - (rows[i])[j]|
end

var failures: ZZ32 := 0
tol: RR64 = 10.0^(-12)
check(name: String, diff: RR64): () = do
  ok = diff <= tol
  if NOT ok then failures += 1 end
  println((if ok then "PASS " else "FAIL ") name ": max abs diff " diff)
end
checkEq(name: String, a: ZZ32, b: ZZ32): () = do
  if a =/= b then failures += 1 end
  println((if a = b then "PASS " else "FAIL ") name ": " a " vs " b)
end

run(): () = do
  println("reference source sha256: " ref_source_sha256)
  nm = names(ref_n_layer)
  var theta: Params := Params({[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] name |-> toArr(initOf(name)) | name <- nm })
  var m: Params := 0.0 theta
  var v: Params := 0.0 theta
  opt = Adam(0.85, 0.99, 10.0^(-8))
  checkEq("num params", SUM[name <- nm] |theta[name]|, 4192)
  for k <- seq(0#ref_num_steps) do
    toks = (ref_tokens())[k]
    println("--- step " k ": doc " (ref_docs())[k] " tokens " toks)
    recordTime(k)
    g = model(theta, ref_n_head, ref_n_layer)
    n = |toks| - 1
    (* forward only: logits, probabilities and per-position losses at every position *)
    logits = g.forward(toks[0 # n])
    P = softmax(logits)
    var dLogits: RR64 := 0.0
    var dProbs: RR64 := 0.0
    var dLosses: RR64 := 0.0
    for t <- seq(0#n) do
      dLogits := dLogits MAX maxAbsDiff((logits[t]).v, ((ref_logits())[k])[t])
      dProbs := dProbs MAX maxAbsDiff((P[t]).v, ((ref_probs())[k])[t])
      dLosses := dLosses MAX |(-log P[t, toks[t + 1]]).v - ((ref_losses())[k])[t]|
    end
    check("logits (all positions)", dLogits)
    check("probabilities (all positions)", dProbs)
    check("per-position losses", dLosses)
    (* the training path: loss, backward, Adam *)
    L = loss(g, toks)
    check("loss", |L.v - (ref_loss())[k]|)
    backward(L)
    gr = grads(g, ref_n_layer)
    for name <- seq(nm) do check("grad " name, matDiff(gr[name], gradOf(name, k))) end
    (theta, m, v) := opt.step(theta, gr, m, v, k + 1, (ref_lr())[k])
    for name <- seq(nm) do check("params after Adam " name, matDiff(theta[name], afterOf(name, k))) end
    printTime(k)
  end

  (* inference with the recorded uniform draws *)
  tk = Tokenizer(ref_uchars)
  for s <- seq(0#ref_num_samples) do
    draws = (ref_sample_draws())[s]
    expected = (ref_sample_tokens())[s]
    var prefix: List[\ZZ32\] := <|[\ZZ32\] tk.bos |>
    var text: String := ""
    var dP: RR64 := 0.0
    var mismatches: ZZ32 := 0
    for j <- seq(0#|draws|) do
      logits = (model(theta, ref_n_head, ref_n_layer).forward(prefix))[j]
      probs = softmax(logits/ref_temperature)
      dP := dP MAX maxAbsDiff(probs.v, ((ref_sample_probs())[s])[j])
      token = pick(probs, draws[j])
      if token =/= expected[j] then mismatches += 1 end
      if token =/= tk.bos then text := text || tk.decode(token) end
      prefix := prefix.addRight(token)
    end
    check("sample " s " probabilities", dP)
    checkEq("sample " s " token mismatches", mismatches, 0)
    if text =/= (ref_sample_text())[s] then failures += 1 end
    println((if text = (ref_sample_text())[s] then "PASS " else "FAIL ") "sample " s " text: " text " (expected " (ref_sample_text())[s] ")")
  end
  println("nodes created: " nodeCount)
  println(if failures = 0 then "ALL CHECKS PASSED" else ("FAILURES: " failures) end)
end
EOF

(* c18: building a Map[\String, Array2\] whose values are matrices of DIFFERENT
   shapes.  A map comprehension fails inside the library's covariant
   collection ("Singleton[(FlatString,__DefaultMatrix[RR64,16,16])] APPCOV
   Singleton[(FlatString,__DefaultMatrix[RR64,64,16])] have no common
   supertype", build/Check.fss run of 2026-09-09).  Three alternatives:
   (a) a list comprehension of pairs with an explicit static argument, fed to
       mapping();  (b) BIG UNION over singleton maps with explicit static
       arguments;  (c) a sequential fold with add. *)
component c18_map_of_shapes
import List.{...}
import Map.{...}
export Executable

shape(name: String): (ZZ32, ZZ32) = if name = "a" then (2, 3) elif name = "b" then (4, 3) else (3, 5) end
make(name: String): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] = do (n, m) = shape(name); array[\RR64\](n, m).fill(1.0) end
nm = <|[\String\] "a", "b", "c" |>

run(): () = do
  (* (c) fold *)
  var mc: Map[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] := {[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] }
  for name <- seq(nm) do mc := mc.add(name, make(name)) end
  println("(c) fold: " (dom(mc)) " sizes " <| (mc[k]).sizes | k <- nm |>)
  (* (b) BIG UNION of singleton maps *)
  mb = BIG UNION[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\][name <- nm] {[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] name |-> make(name) }
  println("(b) BIG UNION: " (dom(mb)) " sizes " <| (mb[k]).sizes | k <- nm |>)
  (* (a) list of pairs with a static argument, then mapping *)
  pairs = <|[\(String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\])\] (name, make(name)) | name <- nm |>
  ma = mapping[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\](pairs)
  println("(a) mapping(pairs): " (dom(ma)) " sizes " <| (ma[k]).sizes | k <- nm |>)
  (* (d) the map comprehension itself, with static arguments, for the record *)
  md = {[\String, Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\]\] name |-> make(name) | name <- nm }
  println("(d) comprehension: " (dom(md)))
end
end

(* Bounded training demo: start from the reference's initial weights, train on
   the first documents of the (seeded, shuffled) dataset with the reference's
   schedule, then sample names with Fortress's own random draws. *)

toArr(ref: List[\List[\RR64\]\]): Array[\RR64,(ZZ32,ZZ32)\] =
  array[\RR64\](|ref|, |ref[0]|).fill(fn (i, j) => (ref[i])[j])
initOf(name: String): List[\List[\RR64\]\] = case name of
    "wte" => ref_init_wte(); "wpe" => ref_init_wpe(); "lm_head" => ref_init_lm_head()
    "layer0.attn_wq" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wq(); "layer0.attn_wk" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wk()
    "layer0.attn_wv" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wv(); "layer0.attn_wo" => ref_init_layer0_attn_wo()
    "layer0.mlp_fc1" => ref_init_layer0_mlp_fc1(); else => ref_init_layer0_mlp_fc2()
  end

run(): () = do
  tk = Tokenizer(ref_uchars)
  docs = ref_docs_head()
  num_steps = 12
  var theta: Params := record(fn name => toArr(initOf(name)), names(ref_n_layer))
  var m: Params := 0.0 theta
  var v: Params := 0.0 theta
  opt = Adam(0.85, 0.99, 10.0^(-8))
  recordTime(0)
  (* FIG train *)
  for step <- seq(0#num_steps) do
    tokens = tk.encode(docs[step MOD |docs|])
    gpt = build(theta, ref_n_head, ref_n_layer)
    L = loss(gpt, tokens.take(ref_block_size + 1))
    backward(L)
    eta = 0.01 (1 - step/num_steps)          (* linear learning-rate decay, as in the reference *)
    (theta, m, v) := opt.step(theta, grads(gpt, ref_n_layer), m, v, step + 1, eta)
    println("step " (step + 1) " / " num_steps " | loss " L.v " | doc " docs[step MOD |docs|])
  end
  (* END FIG *)
  printTime(0)
  println("--- inference (new, hallucinated names) ---")
  (* FIG sample *)
  for s <- seq(0#4) do
    var prefix: List[\ZZ32\] := <|[\ZZ32\] tk.bos |>
    var text: String := ""
    label done
      for j <- seq(0#ref_block_size) do
        logits = (build(theta, ref_n_head, ref_n_layer).forward(prefix))[j]
        token = pick(softmax(logits/ref_temperature), random(1.0))
        if token = tk.bos then exit done with () end
        text := text || tk.decode(token)
        prefix := prefix.addRight(token)
      end
    end done
    println("sample " (s + 1) ": " text)
  end
  (* END FIG *)
  println("nodes created: " nodeCount)
end
EOF
